Liderar time criativo (designers, copywriters, social media, gestor de tráfego)
Dar direcionamento estratégico claro e extrair o melhor desempenho de cada profissional
Criar cultura de teste, aprendizado rápido e melhoria contínua

Experiência
Mínimo 1 ano de experiência em Marketing Digital

Autogerenciável: Gerencia prioridades, atividades e emoções sem necessidade de microgestão

Comunicação direta: Sem rodeios, clara e objetiva

Vaga:Mecânico de Refrigeração – Equipe de Cobertura (Rio de Janeiro) Estamos buscando um Mecânico de Refrigeração para atuar na equipe de cobertura que atende diferentes contratos em toda a cidade do Rio de Janeiro. A equipe de cobertura não possui posto ou horário fixo:as atividades são direcionadas conforme as demandas diárias informadas pela equipe operacional, que define local, escala e período. O salário é fixo, independentemente da cobertura realizada, e nos dias sem demanda o colaborador permanece na base de um contrato até surgir um novo chamado. As folgas são sempre respeitadas conforme a escala. Essa equipe também é responsável por cobrir ausências por faltas, férias ou atestados. Executar regulagem de temperaturas, medições de pressão e amperagem. limpeza de serpentinas, evaporadores, condensadores, bandejas e drenos. substituição de compressores, motores, filtros secadores, válvulas de expansão, rolamentos, correias, contactores e outros componentes. Efetuar revisão elétrica, reaperto de conexões, lavagem e varetamento de condensadores, manutenção de torres de resfriamento e bombas de água gelada ou condensada. realizar vácuo, carga e recarga de gás refrigerante, limpeza de tubulações com nitrogênio e inspeção de anomalias, garantindo o pleno desempenho dos sistemas. Requisitos:Experiência comprovada em refrigeração. Disponibilidade total de horário para atuar em equipe de cobertura Certificado na área de refrigeração será considerado diferencial.

title: Analista de Acervo Técnico Sênior
description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.
Nossos Valores:
Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga:
Estamos em busca de um Analista de Acervo Técnico Sênior que será responsável por organizar toda a documentação de engenharia, fazendo uso de sistemas de gerenciamento eletrônico de documentos (GED) estruturado, atuando diretamente em projetos em andamento e garantindo a qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade das informações. A posição exige perfil analítico e relacional, com capacidade de lidar com grandes volumes de dados e múltiplas interfaces.
Responsabilidades:
Assegurar a disponibilidade das versões mais atualizadas da documentação dos ativos
Manter a integridade dos documentos, prevenindo perdas, danos ou alterações não autorizadas
Classificar e categorizar documentos conforme sistema de codificação predefinido
Organizar estrutura de armazenamento que permita recuperação rápida e eficiente
Realizar auditorias regulares para garantir a abrangência e conformidade do acervo técnico
Manter registros de versionamento para rastrear alterações e revisões
Propor políticas e procedimentos para gestão documental
Treinar usuários nos processos e ferramentas de gestão documental
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de acervo técnico
Atuar na catalogação de documentos oriundos de ambientes não estruturados
Apoiar nas atividades de gestão de mudança que requeiram alteração de documentação de engenharia
Apoiar entregas e indicadores da área, como KPIs de atendimento e evolução documental
Requisitos
Formação superior em Biblioteconomia, Arquivologia ou área relacionadas.
Experiência na área de gestão documental técnica de Engenharia.
Excel avançado.
Inglês intermediário.
Perfil relacional e analítico, com habilidade para atuar com diferentes áreas e projetos simultâneos.
Capacidade de lidar com grandes volumes de dados e documentos técnicos.
Diferencial
Conhecimento em sistemas GED de alto nível. Experiência em Oracle Aconex é desejável.
Experiência em sistemas de gestão documental no ambiente Petrobras.
Conhecimento em Business Intelligence (BI)
Vivência com Sistema Petrobras
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo:
Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo:
Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?
Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.
Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

title: Operador (a) de CFTV
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


Responsável pelo acompanhamento em tempo real das imagens captadas pelas câmeras de segurança, com foco na identificação de comportamentos suspeitos, movimentações irregulares e situações anormais. Deve realizar o registro detalhado de ocorrências e elaborar relatórios diários ou sob demanda, conforme os procedimentos da empresa.

Auxilia no controle de acesso remoto de pessoas e veículos, validando entradas e saídas com base nas imagens e utilização de interfones. Garante a preservação das gravações, verificando se o sistema está registrando corretamente, realizando backups e arquivando imagens sempre que solicitado.

Executa verificações periódicas nos equipamentos de monitoramento, como câmeras, monitores, DVRs/NVRs e conexões, comunicando falhas técnicas ao setor responsável para manutenção preventiva. Atua em apoio à segurança patrimonial, trabalhando em conjunto com vigilantes e acionando responsáveis em situações emergenciais.

Zela pela confidencialidade das informações e pelo uso ético do sistema de monitoramento, mantendo sigilo sobre as imagens e ocorrências internas. Também é responsável por atender solicitações internas, localizando e disponibilizando gravações quando requisitado por supervisores ou órgãos autorizados.

  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório).

  • Cursos de Vigilância ou Segurança Patrimonial (diferencial).
  • Experiência de 6 meses a 1 ano como Operador de CFTV;
  • Vivência com sistemas de monitoramento por câmeras, controle e gravação de imagens;
  • Conhecimento no manuseio de equipamentos como DVR, NVR, câmeras IP e softwares de vigilância;
  • Atuação anterior em ambientes como empresas de segurança, condomínios, comércios, indústrias ou hospitais;
  • Experiência com registro de ocorrências e emissão de relatórios diários.

BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

title: ENGENHEIRO DE SEGURANÇA DE PROCESSO
description:
Responsável pela execução do escopo de trabalho da disciplina de Segurança de Processo & Confiabilidade, com foco na identificação, priorização e avaliação dos riscos de segurança do processo, garantindo constantemente que medidas eficazes de segurança sejam implementadas, levando a processos estáveis e capazes seguindo normas e regulação brasileira, a fim de garantir e maximizar a confiabilidade, disponibilidade, manutenção, segurança e integridade dos ativos (RAMSI), encaminhando o negócio para operações mais seguras e com melhor desempenho, bem como contribuindo para os procedimentos de Operações e atingimento de resultados estabelecidos para o negócio.

Responsible for the execution of the Process Safety & Reliability discipline's scope of work, focusing in identifying, prioritizing, and assessing the process safety risks, constantly ensuring effective safety measures are implemented, leading to stable and capable processes following Standards and Brazilian regulation, in order to ensure and maximize assets reliability, availability, maintainability, safety and integrity (RAMSI), heading the business to safer operations and better performance as well as contributing to the Operations procedures and results achievement.

A
MODEC do BRASIL
está com processo seletivo aberto para contratação de um(a)
ENGENHEIRO(A) DE SEGURANÇA DE PROCESSO
para atuar

no Rio de Janeiro/RJ com atuação exclusiva para operações na Guyana com escopo de trabalho descrito abaixo:

  • Contribuir com a Confiabilidade da Operação e sua performance, no que diz respeito ao gerenciamento de elementos críticos de segurança de processo e diretrizes da disciplina de Segurança de Processo & Confiabilidade, monitorando resultados, executando adequadamente investigações de causa raiz, e fornecendo revisão/recomendação técnica.
  • Contribuir e suportar a disciplina de Segurança de Processo & Confiabilidade com soluções, lições aprendidas e conhecimento através da sugestão e controle de indicadores e novos relatórios.
  • Contribuir com a melhoria do desempenho e segurança da frota, analisando MOCs, TQs, NOIs etc., participando RCA/FMEAs etc. e fornecendo recomendações técnicas a fim de apoiar a equipe de Operação.
  • Monitorar a efetividade dos processos das barreiras segurança para manter a operação da instalação dentro do nível ALARP, monitorando e gerenciando seus indicadores e fornecendo recomendação técnica se for necessário.
  • Participar de workshops de análise de risco, estudos de segurança e revisões técnicas e gerenciar a implementação das recomendações de estudos de segurança desenvolvidas durante a fase de operação, garantindo a inclusão das recomendações de estudos de segurança no sistema de gerenciamento de rastreamento de ações de segurança e verificando a efetividade de todas as recomendações com evidências adequadas no sistema.
  • Participar de embarques periódicos das embarcações para promover valores de segurança de processos, cultura e conscientização entre as equipes de operações.

  • Fornecer informações de segurança de processos relacionados a confiabilidade e segurança da frota, executando a atualização e revisão do Estudo de Segurança de 5 anos (por exemplo, FSA e MAH case), protocolos de estudo de segurança, e revisão e validação de relatórios de avaliação de riscos para apoiar a equipe de Operações, a fim de garantir que todos os aspectos sejam analisados. Além disso, auxiliar o líder da disciplina a monitorar, manter e conduzir a revalidação periódica do registro MAH, Bowtie e listas de SCE para a frota em operação.
  • Ser o responsável pela classificação de eventos de segurança de processos (PSE), classificando-os de acordo com a sua criticidade e avaliando medidas adicionais de controle, lições aprendidas, dentre outras.
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas (ANP, clientes e outras) relacionadas a segurança de processos.

MODEC do BRASIL
is hiring a
PROCESS SAFETY ENGINEER
to work
ONSHORE
in Rio de Janeiro with exclusive activities for Guyana's operations developing activities such as described below:

Furthermore, support discipline lead to monitor, maintain and conduct the periodic revalidation of the MAH Register, Bowtie and SCE lists for the operating fleet.

About Air Liquide

Through the passion and diversity of its people, Air Liquide leverages the energy and environmental transition, healthcare changes and digitalization, and delivers greater value to all its shareholders.

Join us for a stimulating experience: you will find a world of learning and development opportunities where creativity is at the heart of what we do, in an open, collaborative and respectful environment.

  • Desenvolvimento de Novos Negócios (Hunter): Atuar ativamente na prospecção de novos clientes e na abertura de novas frentes de mercado, superando consistentemente as metas de vendas e faturamento.

  • Venda Consultiva/técnica do setor de gases medicinais e infra-estrutura hospitalar: Desenvolver propostas de valor complexas e soluções personalizadas, com aprofundamento técnico, atuando como um consultor estratégico para o cliente.

  • Gestão de Processos: Liderar o ciclo completo de vendas, desde a qualificação, negociação, até o fechamento e acompanhamento pós-venda, com foco em excelência operacional e satisfação do cliente, utilizando planejamento estratégico para otimizar recursos.

  • Colaboração Interdepartamental: Trabalhar de forma proativa e sinérgica com as equipes de Engenharia, Operações e Suporte, garantindo a viabilidade técnica e regulatória dos projetos.

Do you have these requirements?

  • Formação Superior: Preferencialmente em Engenharia (mecânica, química, elétrica) ou em Áreas da Saúde (farmácia, fisioterapia, enfermagem).

  • Setor: Experiência prévia no segmento de Gases Medicinais, OnSites, gases criogênicos, infra-estrurura hospitalar,  Saúde ou Medical Devices é um diferencial altamente valorizado.

Requisitos Adicionais

  • Direção: Experiência comprovada em direção veicular, com posse de Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) categoria B por alguns anos.

  • Disponibilidade: Total disponibilidade para viagens longas e frequentes, inerente à gestão de contas em território expandido. Raio de atuação até 350km aproximadamente.

  • Conhecimento Técnico/Regulatório: Experiência comprovada em processos de Licitação (compliance e concorrências públicas) e profundo conhecimento da Regulação específica do setor de Saúde e Gases Medicinais.

Your differences drive our performance

At Air Liquide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, which means that, regardless of your gender identity, sexual orientation, color, age, religion, nationality or disability, we value a work environment made up of true stories, built by true people. 
Our processes reflect this, being diverse and free from any prejudice, therefore, we do not collect information such as date of birth, gender, marital status or full address in our selection stages. If this information is sent, it will be disregarded. 

We strongly believe that a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively, and helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

title: Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions
description:
Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • A passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • An appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Oil Reservoir Management Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Please note that this role is based in Saudi Arabia on a permanent, residential basis.

Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer with extensive experience in Oil Reservoir Management to join our Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran. Our Center provides expert advice and guidance on all aspects of oil reservoir management, including designing, participating in and implementing best‑in‑class reservoir management programs. This position is embedded within the Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical specialist, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Your primary role is to manage some of the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields, conduct pioneering research, introduce new technologies and provide specialized engineering services as part of the customized reservoir management practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and oversight on best-in-class reservoir management tenets, practices and state of the art technologies for all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance and monitoring master-plans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.
  • Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both net present value and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare reservoir engineering input into drilling and work-over proposals and programs.
  • Recommend advanced completion techniques for horizontal and multi-lateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies that include reservoir stimulation modeling of various International Offshore Rule (IOR) processes for improvement of ultimate recovery.
  • Participate in technical societies and technical groups.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor degree in Petroleum Engineering or related discipline. A Master degree or PhD is desirable, but not required.
  • Have a minimum of 10 years related experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management. A training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected. Technical publications are valued but in‑depth practical experience is paramount.
  • Must have full professional proficiency in English required to interact and communicate clearly with specialists in geology, core and fluid analysis, petrophysics, simulation, drilling, completion, production and facilities.
  • Must have working knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures, strategy technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis and fluid compatibility. Additionally, expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are desirable but not required.
  • Must have history of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. We invest heavily in talent development and encourage continuous learning through extensive workforce development programs.

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments

Nice to have
  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success

Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT.

  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi Case

CEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

Um profissional que consiga ser um gestor de projetos eficaz, garantindo que a obra:

As principais funções do síndico no contexto de obras são:

    Exigir o cumprimento da NBR 16.280 e do regimento interno do condomínio em todas as reformas, seja nas áreas comuns ou nas unidades privativas.

    • Habilidade em Análise de Documentos: analisar e arquivar corretamente ARTs, RRTs, laudos de inspeção, contratos e garantias.

    • Transparência: garantir clareza na seleção de fornecedores e prestação de contas.
  • III. Requisitos Comportamentais (Perfil)

    • Capacidade de Comunicação: informar moradores sobre impacto e dialogar com empreiteira.

title: Psicólogo - Supervisor ABA
description:
MISSÃO

Desenvolver, supervisionar e garantir a eficácia dos padrões clínicos e das intervenções baseadas em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) na Jano Saúde, promovendo a qualidade dos atendimentos, a formação da equipe clínica e a adesão às melhores práticas com base em evidências científicas. Atua também como facilitador da coordenação do cuidado e da integração com famílias, escolas e equipes interdisciplinares.

ATIVIDADES

Acolhida/contato inicial com o aprendiz, família, escola e equipe multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial de famílias e indivíduos neuro divergentes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, assim como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas, para o delineamento da intervenção.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe multidisciplinar possam ter sobre a intervenção.

Avaliação comportamental e desenvolvimento do plano de tratamento individualizado (PTI)

  • Planejar e realizar avaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.
  • Planejar e realizar avaliações funcionais.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e protocolos, programas ou procedimentos individualizados de ensino de habilidades, prevenção e redução de problemas de comportamento do aprendiz com base na função.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório a cada 4 meses.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida a cada 1 ano.
  • Definir carga horária e local de tratamento do cliente.

Intervenção

  • Confeccionar o plano de intervenção individualizado (PTI) do aprendiz.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais instrucionais (programas e descrição de procedimentos) e folhas de registro necessárias para a implementação da intervenção.
  • Supervisionar no mínimo 10% da carga horária de intervenção, distribuídas em horas de supervisão diretas e indiretas.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos comportamentos na intervenção a partir da análise dos dados sistematizados e/ou observação direta (na presença e na ausência do aprendiz).
  • Realizar relatórios de evolução mensal para plano de saúde quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os planos de transição entre equipes, desligamento ou alta do aprendiz.
  • Redigir documentos como pautas e atas de reuniões realizadas com familiares e equipe.
  • Modificar ou descontinuar do serviço prestado, baseado na avaliação dos riscos e benefícios de continuar a intervenção ou substituí-la por práticas alternativas, estando a decisão formalizada em prontuário/ficha de atendimento do aprendiz.

Coordenação, monitoramento e treinamento

  • Avaliar e prover feedback do desempenho da equipe de intervenção comportamental e familiares na implementação dos procedimentos delineados para o aprendiz.
  • Realizar orientação e treino parental.
  • Coordenar, orientar e treinar a equipe de intervenção, os familiares, cuidadores e outras pessoas significativas, a implementar os programas e procedimentos delineados, na presença e na ausência do aprendiz.
  • Realizar comunicação e treinamento, quando necessário, da equipe de coordenação de cuidado.

ESCOLARIDADE / FORMAÇÃO

  • Ensino superior em psicologia, com carteira do conselho ativa.
  • Pós graduação completa em análise do comportamento aplicada ao TEA.
  • Ter obtido título de mestre ou doutor em análise do comportamento ou áreas associadas ao desenvolvimento atípico (diferencial).
  • Certificação em procedimento de gerenciamento de crises agressivas (diferencial).

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

  • Experiência anterior como supervisor ABA acima de 1 ano.

title: Técnico de Engenharia Clínica
description:
Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica

O Técnico de Engenharia Clínica é o profissional técnico responsável por assegurar o funcionamento contínuo, seguro e eficaz do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos. Sua atuação é fundamental para a segurança do paciente e a eficiência operacional da instituição de saúde.

  • Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas: Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura. Executar manutenções planejadas/programadas (preventivas e preditivas), utilizando padrões e simuladores adequados, para garantir que os equipamentos estejam sempre aptos para uso seguro, com laudos e certificados válidos. Realizar calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica nos equipamentos, seguindo os procedimentos e normas técnicas aplicáveis, para assegurar a precisão e a segurança dos dispositivos.
  • Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial: Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade. Acompanhar o recebimento de novos equipamentos e insumos, conferindo notas fiscais e a contagem dos produtos, e testando os equipamentos para verificar sua aptidão para o uso. Preservar e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, mantendo-os organizados, limpos e conservados, e solicitando novas ferramentas ao supervisor quando necessário, demonstrando cuidado com o patrimônio da empresa.
  • Documentação e Registro no Sistema: Alimentar o sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), realizando a abertura de Ordens de Serviço (OS) e preenchendo detalhadamente as ações executadas, peças utilizadas e observações, para garantir um histórico preciso e completo do equipamento. Assegurar a correta emissão de laudos e certificados de acordo com as normativas vigentes, após a execução das manutenções e calibrações.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Manter o supervisor imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e os desafios encontrados, buscando soluções e alinhando as atividades diariamente. Acompanhar as atividades de serviços realizados por terceiros dentro da unidade, por meio da análise de ordens de serviço externas, para garantir o registro e histórico completo dos equipamentos. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo que venham a ser delegadas pelo supervisor de engenharia clínica.
  • Relacionamento e Otimização: Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações conforme a necessidade do cliente, através do contato com fornecedores, com o objetivo de apoiar a ampliação dos serviços e soluções oferecidas.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level

Employment type: Full‑time

Job function: Engineering and Information Technology

Overview

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine at Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC). Reports To: Chief Medical Officer. FLSA Status: Exempt. Wage Range: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly.

Summary: Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results, the Physician provides primary healthcare services for CHC and performs related work as required. CHC aims to provide the highest quality of total care to the patient population; employees are expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Secure and evaluate a patient''s health history and record findings in a systematic, accurate, and succinct manner.
  • Perform physical assessments and discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.
  • Provide routine physical examinations, diagnostic services, and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.
  • Adhere to high ethical standards and assure quality of care for all patients.
  • Share on-call duties with other medical staff as indicated.
  • Elicit and record information about patient medical history; examine patients to determine general physical condition.
  • Order or execute tests, analyses, and diagnostic images; analyze reports and findings to diagnose conditions.
  • Administer or prescribe treatments and drugs; inoculate and vaccinate patients; advise on diet, hygiene, and disease prevention.
  • Report births, deaths, and outbreaks to governmental authorities; refer patients to specialists when needed.
  • Perform minor surgeries and conduct physicals for school admissions, job considerations, or insurance eligibility.
  • Assist the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies and education programs; participate in care coordination and policy development as required.
  • Share supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required; work within privileges and protocols established by the CMO.
  • Participate in committees as requested; adhere to safety and infection control policies; provide age-appropriate care across patient populations.
  • Maintain HIPAA-compliant, confidential communications; participate in patient population management with cultural sensitivity and appropriate local resources.
  • Coordinate with the Care Team to arrange appropriate services and support patient goals; contribute to quality improvement using evidence-based practices.

Supervisory Responsibilities

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Qualifications

  • Education: Medical Doctor (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency: Completion in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN, or Pediatrics; board certified or board eligible.
  • Licenses and Certifications: Current, unrestricted Physician and Surgeon license in California; current DEA license; ACLS for FP/IM; PALS for Pediatrics; BLS (all specialties).

  • Language Skills: English required; Spanish bilingual desirable.

Education And/or Experience

As listed under Qualifications above.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to perform essential duties and accommodate reasonable accommodations as needed.
  • Physical demands and work environment as described below may apply: willing to work flexible hours, occasional travel to other clinic sites.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.
While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
This role reports to the CISO.
What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness
Optional things we value
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

As a Business Analyst , you will play a pivotal part in the design, development, and deployment of a cutting-edge preventative security platform for a high-profile client. This platform will significantly enhance their security posture across diverse cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.) and hybrid environments.

How you'll contribute

  • Conduct in-depth interviews, workshops, and brainstorming sessions to elicit, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements for the preventative security platform, always with a keen eye on delivering measurable value.

  • Support the development of comprehensive test plans and UAT scenarios, rigorously validating that the implemented solution meets business requirements and delivers the expected value.
  • Contribute to change management activities, including the development of communication and training materials, to ensure smooth adoption of the new security platform for the client.

This would make you the ideal candidate

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience working as a Business Analyst, with a strong background in client-facing roles within a consulting environment, ideally with a focus on cybersecurity or platform development.
  • Proven experience in gathering, analyzing, and documenting requirements for complex software platforms, with a track record of driving outcomes and delivering tangible value to clients.
  • Familiarity with various cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid infrastructure architectures.
  • Proficiency in using business analysis tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Visio, Lucidchart, requirement management software).
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team in a fast-paced consulting environment, often balancing multiple priorities.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

What to expect from our hiring process

  1. Let’s chat about your experience!
  2. Impress our recruiters, and you’ll move on to a technical interview with our top developers.
  3. Nail that, and you’ll meet our client - your final step to joining our amazing team!

Canonical is building a comprehensive suite of multi-cloud and on-premise data solutions for the enterprise. We want to make it easy to operate any database on any cloud, or on premise. The data platform team covers the full range of data stores and data technologies, spanning from big data, NoSQL, cache-layer capabilities, and analytics; all the way to structured SQL engines like Postgres and MySQL. title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
Enterprise Sales Manager

Job Purpose

The Enterprise Sales Manager is responsible for driving new revenue growth through proactive outreach, prospecting, and pipeline development, while also expanding existing enterprise customer relationships. Leads will be generated through multiple channels, including marketing campaigns, third‑party lead generation, and self‑sourced outreach.

An Enterprise customer is defined as any organisation with 200+ white‑collar employees, and the role will span both national and international client requirements, depending on account footprint and opportunity scope.

This role plays a critical part in positioning IWG’s full suite of solutions to large organisations across multiple markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate profitable new revenue by identifying, prospecting, and converting new Enterprise clients.
  • Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified sales opportunities across multiple sectors and geographies.
  • Conduct strategic outreach through direct engagement, events, and third‑party referrals to identify high‑potential prospects.
  • Own the full sales cycle — from first contact to close — with an emphasis on front‑end activity and deal progression.
  • Create and execute Account Plans to grow wallet share within assigned strategic accounts.
  • Build and maintain executive‑level relationships to gain insight into client needs and translate insights into tailored workspace solutions.
  • Collaborate with brokers, real estate advisors, and consultants to generate opportunities and increase IWG’s market visibility.
  • Partner cross‑functionally with regional Sales, Operations, and Product teams to ensure seamless solution delivery.
  • Continuously gather and share feedback from prospects and clients to improve product‑market fit and go‑to‑market effectiveness.
  • Deliver accurate pipeline forecasts, activity reports, and performance updates.

Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven track record in B2B prospecting, business development, and solution selling.
  • Ability to independently source and qualify leads in complex, consultative sales environments.
  • Strong understanding of the enterprise customer buying journey and long‑cycle deal management.
  • Experience working with and influencing C‑level stakeholders.
  • Background in commercial real estate, enterprise services, or flexible workspace is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets through self‑generated pipeline.
  • Strong negotiation and contract structuring skills.
  • High level of commercial acumen and results orientation.
  • Comfortable working in global, matrixed organisations with distributed teams.
  • Adaptable, proactive, and confident navigating ambiguity.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.
  • Native Portuguese and fluent/conversational English

About the company

IWG has been at the forefront of flexible working for more than 30 years. With over 3,500 locations around the globe, spanning brands including Regus, Spaces, Signature and HQ, we have made it possible for businesses of all sizes to make the transition to hybrid working, empowering employees to work wherever and whenever is most convenient.

We help more than 8 million people and their businesses to work more productively, supported by a choice of professional, inspiring and collaborative workspaces, communities and services.

As the world’s leading provider of hybrid work solutions, with four times the number of locations compared to its nearest competitor, IWG is already working with over 80% of the Fortune 500 and counts businesses including Amazon, Netflix, EY and Uber amongst its customers.

Companies of all sizes are shifting to flexible working to lower costs, improve employee retention and lower their carbon emissions. The flexible workspace is expected to grow by 600% by 2023, when 30% of all office space will be hybrid. We are growing our network faster than ever to keep up with demand from customers as we work towards our goal of reaching 30,000 centres.

Carbon Neutral Workplaces

IWG’s purpose of helping everyone have a great day at work, while protecting people and the planet is at the heart of everything we do. We are proud to supply all of our customers worldwide with carbon neutral workplaces, and we have a strong climate action plan in place to help us achieve our objective of Net Zero emissions by 2040.

Leading Employer Award IWG is proud to be the recipient of a Leading Employer Award in 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025. Awarded exclusively to the top 1% of employers, the accolade is testament to our diverse global workforce and the role everyone plays in bringing our purpose, culture and values to life, every single day.

title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance.

With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy.

We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co‑founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

The Role

As a Compliance Analyst at Crown, you will be a cornerstone of our risk management framework, operating across both the first and second lines of defense. You will serve as the primary compliance liaison for our institutional clients and partners, guiding them through our rigorous due diligence process while performing critical risk analysis to protect the firm. This role requires a unique blend of client‑facing communication skills and deep analytical rigor. You will work directly with the Chief Compliance Officer and the broader risk function to implement and uphold our institutional‑grade AML/CFT Policy.

  • Institutional Onboarding (1st Line): Act as the main point of contact for institutional clients during the entire onboarding lifecycle. You will guide them through the appropriate Due Diligence Questionnaire (for Brazilian, U.S., or other non‑U.S. entities), ensuring all mandatory documentation—such as constitutional documents, AML/CFT policies, and ownership charts—is collected completely and accurately.
  • Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Risk Assessment (2nd Line): Conduct comprehensive reviews of prospective clients, applying our risk‑based approach. This includes analyzing complex corporate structures to identify and verify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) according to our dynamic thresholds.
  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Execute enhanced due diligence for high‑risk clients, including Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), VASPs, and other financial institutions. This involves a critical assessment of the client’s own AML program, their independent audit reports, and the source of their funds and wealth.
  • Transaction Monitoring Support (2nd Line): Assist in the analysis of alerts generated by our on‑chain and fiat transaction monitoring systems. You will investigate atypical activity, adhering to strict internal SLAs for resolution (e.g., 24 hours for critical alerts), and prepare dossiers for potential Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to be submitted to COAF.
  • Record Keeping and Data Protection: Ensure all due diligence, risk assessments, and client communications are meticulously documented and securely stored, in compliance with our policies and regulatory requirements. You will handle highly sensitive client data and must adhere strictly to our Information Security Policy and data protection principles (LGPD).

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a compliance, KYC/AML, risk, or client onboarding role within a VASP, fintech, or regulated financial institution.
  • You have a deep and practical understanding of Brazilian AML/CFT regulations (e.g., Law 14.478/22, COAF reporting) and are familiar with international FATF standards.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills required to interact with sophisticated institutional clients and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a highly analytical mindset and an obsessive attention to detail, capable of dissecting complex legal and corporate structures to identify underlying risks.
  • You thrive in ownership-driven environments. You’re highly accountable for your work and don’t require others following up on it.
  • You naturally operate cross-functionally, with strong collaborative instincts toward legal, operations, and technology teams.
  • You are energized by the challenge of building and refining compliance processes from the ground up in a fast-paced environment.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design. We don’t hire layers of managers. Everyone builds.
  • Ownership is total. You own the function end‑to‑end—and ask for input when it makes the work better, not because someone’s checking.
  • Ruthlessly simple. We don’t paper over complexity with process or headcount.
  • Collaboration is default. Problems are shared property. We work across domains.
  • Feedback is candid and direct. Built on the assumption that everyone here is smart, competent, and cares.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Full health coverage
  • VA

description:
