1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Nossa equipe está crescendo e por isso estamos à procura de pessoas cheias de garra, que amem fazer a diferença na vida do outro, que sejam fascinadas por aprender e queiram fazer parte de algo muito maior!

Não encontrou uma vaga com a sua cara? Fique tranquilo! Você ainda pode ser Placi! Inscreva-se no nosso banco de talentos e, assim que uma oportunidade que tenha mais haver com você aparecer, entraremos em contato!

A cadeia de saúde no Brasil tinha uma lacuna entre o modelo altamente tecnológico voltado para tratamento intensivo do hospital geral e o seu retorno para a sua residência.

Por este motivo, o Hospital Placi chegou para ocupar esse espaço no tratamento pós agudo, oferecendo um atendimento humanizado e acolhedor com uma proposta do cuidado individualizado para:

  • Reabilitação;
  • Readequação de cuidados;
  • Cuidados Paliativos Oncológicos e não oncológicos;

Inauguramos em 2013 a nossa primeira unidade em Niterói com a missão de: acolher, cuidar e recuperar pessoas. Não paramos por aí! Em 2016, expandimos para Botafogo e em breve novas unidades estarão próximas a você.

Nossa essência é "cuidar Bem é fazer Bem" e para isso contamos com uma equipe interdisciplinar com excelência técnica para fornecer todo o suporte aos pacientes, familiares e equipe assistente.

Seguimos com o propósito de trazer vida para todos os momentos de vida , levando o cuidado certo no momento certo!

Somos pessoas cuidando de pessoas. Atuamos com relação próxima e respeitosa, temos orgulho de fazer a diferença no cuidado de todos aqueles que precisam dos nossos serviços.

Mais do que um hospital de transição, somos um time que tem como propósito cuidar!

Quer fazer parte dessa história para cuidarmos juntos dos nossos pacientes?

title: Document Controller
description:
Advert 2H Offshore is a global engineering contractor specializing in the design, engineering and integrity management of offshore structures, topsides facilities, subsea components and riser and conductor systems for the offshore oil and gas and renewables sectors. Both market sectors require similar engineering skill sets, and our breadth of experience in offshore structures and environments allows us to provide expertise at all stages of a project: feasibility and concept design, detailed design, procurement management, fabrication support, installation support, monitoring, integrity management, asset life extension and decommissioning.
2H Offshore is seeking an experienced Document Controller to join our team and support large-scale subsea engineering projects. The ideal candidate will take ownership of document control processes, ensuring compliance with internal standards and client requirements. This is not an administrative role—we need someone with proven expertise in document management systems, document lifecycle workflows, and quality assurance protocols, who can proactively support project teams and contribute to efficient project execution.
The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.
**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.
Duties
•Implement and manage document control procedures aligned with company and client standards
•Maintain accurate records of incoming and outgoing documentation, including engineering deliverables, technical reports, and correspondence
•Ensure version control, document traceability, and appropriate metadata tagging across all project files
•Coordinate with engineering, procurement, project management, and external stakeholders to manage document workflows and approvals
•Monitor document deadlines and ensure timely distribution of critical information
•Conduct regular audits to verify compliance and data integrity
•Train team members on document control systems and best practices as required
•Interface with client document control systems, ensuring consistency and alignment
•Support preparation of project handovers, final documentation, and close-out packages
Required
•Proven experience as a document controller in the oil & gas or offshore engineering sector, ideally with exposure to subsea projects
•Strong understanding of document control standards, numbering systems, and ISO-based procedures
•Proficiency in document management platforms (e.g., SharePoint, Aconex, OpenText, or client-specific DMS)
•Strong communication skills in English
•Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
•Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, technical environment
•Familiarity with engineering terminology and project documentation (e.g., drawings, MTOs, technical specs)
•Degree or diploma in engineering, administration, or related field is preferred

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017 out of a conviction that iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different, Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist – a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug‑and‑play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem‑solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high‑performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest‑growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands‑on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

Fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data‑driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e‑commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in‑house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to life, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in‑house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set‑up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e‑commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e‑commerce clients.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.
  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e‑commerce marketing industry.
  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.
  • You're used to working in a fast‑paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 2‑4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e‑commerce, etc.
  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.
  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside the box to create new best‑in‑class customer experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, São Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

  • Analisar conectividade :
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP :
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução .

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes .
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE .
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping , tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS .
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6 .
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA , etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conhece TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana) .
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG .
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim , sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo .
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa .

The role of a Technical Author
A Technical Author leads the documentation efforts of an engineering team, typically focused on a product or family of products. You'll help the team develop documentation that serves the needs of the product's users, embracing the principles of the Diátaxis documentation framework. You will have a broad impact on - and responsibility for - the quality of the user experience with the product, and will contribute towards the long-term success of the project itself.
These are not traditional technical writer roles. As a Technical Author, you will participate in development of product strategy. You will have input into product design and user experience. Even the most junior Technical Authors will have the opportunity to develop and demonstrate technical authority.
As well as your role in an engineering team, you will also be a part of Canonical's documentation practice team, that includes all the company's Technical Authors. title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies, Fast Company\u2019s Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies. We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S., a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work.

Interested in data privacy? Check out our policies on Privacy and CA Candidate Privacy.

description:
Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento;
  • Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica;
  • Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações;
  • Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações;
  • Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória;
  • Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado;
  • Manter sala de imobilização organizada;
  • Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade;
  • Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual;
  • Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados;
  • Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes;
  • Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento;
  • Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade;
  • Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica.
  • Registro no conselho de Classe.
  • Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses.
  • Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos.
  • Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia.

  • Convênio Odontológico;

Overview

The position is for the Senior Manager, Telecom at FIFA Women’s World Cup . FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Department: Technology

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Telecom Manager is responsible for managing the Telecom Infrastructure planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties on the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Telecom services pertinent to the tournament and/or associated events within Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review Telecom Infrastructure design and ensure all aspects of the Telecom deliverables are implemented at venues and offices according to FIFA requirements: Broadcast Contribution Network, Event/Stadium/Offices/Legacy Networks, CATV/IPTV, Cabling, Mobile Network, Radio and Spectrum, Telephony (VoIP), Telecom Rate Card.
  • Actively participate in the scope definition, procurement liaison, supplier selection and onboarding of Telecom and Network suppliers
  • Lead the management of Telecom infrastructure build and implementation, ensuring timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and decommissioning of venues.
  • Overseeing the effective and efficient provision of Telecom services for FIFA Offices, Tournaments and Events at select FIFA Events.
  • Track the progress of Telecom Infrastructure implementation, report status, issues and risks related to Telecom Infrastructure projects and operations, according to IT governance and keep counterpart aligned.
  • Manage an international Team of Telecom Experts/Managers including remote personnel in other countries/time zones.
  • Liaise with and/or support other projects in clarifying requirements, adhering to robust change management protocol.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to the delivery and support of Telecom Infrastructure are communicated to and well understood by all parties.
  • Deliver technical guidance, coaching & mentoring to team members, including preparation of good practice and educational material for personnel.

Your Profile

  • University degree or similar higher education in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum experience of 8-10 years in Network (routing/switching/security/wireless technologies)
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex Telecom Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professionals
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Telecom Infrastructure Service, including infrastructure design and implementation, network integration and connectivity.
  • Broad understanding of Telecom Infrastructure and Information Technologies in Sport Events with sufficient experience in design, commissioning and operation of BCN, WAN/MAN/LAN, MPLS, VLAN, VoIP, CATV/IPTV, Multicast, Spectrum, Mobile Networks
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Aptitude for consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR/ ES/ GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%), with some trips lasting 15 days or more
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

Limites e operação (poço aberto e poço revestido); Influência do direcional nas descidas a cabo por gravidade; Noções de projeto de BHA: tubulares, alargadores, escareadores, percussores de perfuração; Noções de operação e projeto utilizando sistemas de alargamento (alargadores, ferramentas de eliminação de offset broca x alargador em manobra única, estabilização no poço alargado etc.); Noções de simulação: torque e drag, hidráulica de poço e desgaste de revestimento; Noções de brocas de perfuração: seleção e cálculo de hidráulica; Noções de hidráulica de poço: correlação entre limpeza de poço e geometria de trajetória; Noções de segurança de poço e análise anticolisão entre poços; Noções de geologia e geodésia; Noções de orçamentação de poços; Noções de operação e projeto de testemunhagem; Noções de operações e projeto de canhoneio; Noções de operações e projeto de MPD; Noções básicas dos tipos de completação (contenção de areia, completações simples e inteligentes, etc.); Noções básicas sobre cimentação, recimentação e correção da cimentação; Aplicação do canhoneio nos diferentes tipos de completação (cargas e densidades); Noções básicas de workover e de abandono; Noções básicas de caracterização de reservatório (geologia, geofísica e avaliação de reservatórios); Idiomas: Português (Brasil) - escrita e oral – nível fluente; Inglês técnico - escrita e oral - nível intermediário; Possuir noções básicas de construção de poços marítimos e dos equipamentos e sistemas de unidades de perfuração marítima; Desejáveis noções básicas em brocas, perfuração direcional, MPD, integridade de poços, estabilidade geomecânica de poços, fundações de poços, fluidos de perfuração, cimentação e equipamentos que compõem a estrutura de poços (cabeça de poço, revestimentos etc).

Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on‑boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on‑boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities

  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on‑boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on‑boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem‑solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world‑class on‑boarding experience.

  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

description:

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

Type of role

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well‑suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases. You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups.

What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviours (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to get started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: what’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, “what could go wrong”)
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

title: Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

Em 2013, ampliamos nossa atuação para o varejo farmacêutico por meio da Rede d1000, composta por mais de 270 lojas sob as bandeiras Drogasmil, Farmalife, Drogarias Tamoio e Drogaria Rosário.

Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem-estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma

Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades.

PROJETISTA ELETROMECÂNICO DE LINHAS DE TRANSMISSÃO - RIO DE JANEIRO

SOBRE A NIP DO BRASIL
Somos uma empresa de engenharia consultiva especializada em soluções para infraestrutura, energia e meio ambiente. Atuamos com inovação, precisão técnica e responsabilidade socioambiental. Nossa missão é transformar desafios em soluções sustentáveis, gerando impacto positivo para o Brasil e suas comunidades.

Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, inclusivo e focado no desenvolvimento humano. Na NIP, cada pessoa tem espaço para crescer e contribuir com propósito.

Missão da Posição

Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos eletromecânicos de linhas de transmissão até 138kV, com foco em qualidade técnica, atendimento aos requisitos normativos e prazos contratuais. Contribuir de forma estratégica para o desempenho dos projetos da NIP, liderando entregas técnicas, interações com clientes e acompanhando a equipe de engenharia.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Levantar dados preliminares de campo e referências técnicas (topografia, georreferenciamento, interferências, servidões, condicionantes ambientais).
  • Definir traçado da linha, escolher o melhor percurso considerando restrições técnicas, ambientais e custos, com otimização de rota.
  • Dimensionar eletromecânica e elétrica da linha (condutores, para-raios, isoladores, espaçamentos, esforços de tração e flecha), incorporando critérios de amortecimento, vibração e fadiga.
  • Projetar estruturas de sustentação (torres, postes), definindo tipologia, perfis, empenos, cargas de vento, gelo (quando aplicável) e requisitos de fabricação.
  • Projetar fundações para torres / postes com base nos levantamentos geotécnicos e cargas atuantes.
  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos e memoriais de cálculo que detalhem hipóteses adotadas, normas aplicadas, critérios de dimensionamento e justificativas técnicas.
  • Produzir desenhos executivos e detalhamentos (plantas, cortes longitudinais e transversais, arranjos, fixações, grampos, emendas).
  • Definir o sistema de aterramento das estruturas e condutores, malha de terra compatível com segurança elétrica e regulamentos.
  • Realizar compatibilização técnica com disciplinas complementares (civil, proteção, telecomunicações, automação), garantindo integração dos projetos.
  • Aplicar e garantir conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais (ABNT, IEC, normas de concessionárias) e regulamentos setoriais.
  • Adaptar projetos conforme requisitos contratuais de clientes ou exigências de concessionárias / clientes, acompanhando revisões e solicitações.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes, fornecedores, órgãos reguladores e equipes de obra para alinhamento de soluções, esclarecimento de dúvidas e decisões de projeto.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas de projeto, distribuir tarefas entre equipe de projetistas, revisar entregas, monitorar prazos e qualidade técnica.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais para acompanhamento de status do projeto, performance da equipe, indicadores de progresso e apoio à gestão.
  • Apoiar a execução da obra fornecendo suporte técnico, esclarecimentos de campo, checagem de conformidade entre projeto e execução e ajustes quando necessário.
  • Garantir que o projeto atenda requisitos de confiabilidade, manutenibilidade, durabilidade e segurança elétrica ao longo do ciclo de vida da linha.

description:
Join to apply for the AI/ML Engineer Tech Lead Manager role at Shape Digital

We are looking for a AI/ML Engineer Tech Lead Manager to act as one of the key leaders within our Data Science discipline. This role combines team management, hands‑on technical contribution and strong product partnership to ensure the delivery of high‑quality, scalable and business‑driven AI solutions.

The Tech Lead Manager will guide a team of Data Scientists, support planning and prioritization across initiatives and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to drive clarity, alignment and iterative value delivery. This person will remain technically involved, contributing to experimentation, design decisions, and the development of robust end‑to‑end solutions while helping elevate standards and practices across the discipline. It’s also important to stay connected to emerging trends in AI and modern ML technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and support Data Scientists through coaching, feedback and structured team rituals.
  • Cultivate a challenging and inspiring environment that supports the company to retain, attract and hire people who are talented and better than you.
  • Ensure clear planning, prioritization and execution across multiple streams.
  • Contribute to product and technical roadmaps, helping shape priorities and delivery plans.
  • Identify opportunities for AI solutions and work with domain experts to translate real problems.
  • Contribute hands‑on to model exploration, experimentation, architecture decisions and solution design.
  • Maintain high engineering and scientific standards: reproducibility, documentation, evaluation and deployment readiness.
  • Guide end‑to‑end solution development, ensuring scalability, maintainability and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with other leaders to evolve shared frameworks, processes and best practices.
  • Promote a culture of iteration, incremental value delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Stay up to date with modern ML and AI trends, especially around LLMs and emerging technologies.
  • Foster internal knowledge sharing and contribute to the growth of the technical community.
  • Lead the elaboration of research papers, technical publications and patent applications derived from the team's innovative AI methods and solutions, while safeguarding intellectual property.

Requirements

  • Degree in a STEM field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, etc.).
  • Experience leading Data Science teams or mentoring senior‑level Data Scientists.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in AI, Machine Learning, Python and SQL.
  • Solid knowledge of ML frameworks such as Scikit‑Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch.
  • Proven experience designing, building and deploying ML solutions in production.
  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem solver with ability to manage and lead the team to push solution & progress.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Product and Engineering organizations.
  • English proficiency required.

Differentials

  • Experience in the industrial or manufacturing sector.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM‑based solutions.
  • Experience with cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Benefits

  • PPR (Profit Sharing): Possibility of extra compensation based on the company’s results, according to your performance.
  • Health and Dental Plan: To ensure your care and well‑being!
  • Flexible Benefit: Receive an amount that can be used according to your needs, including food, transportation, education, culture, and health. You decide how to use it!
  • Flexible Hours: Work at the best time for you and have a better quality of life.
  • Massages and Manicure in the Office: So you can relax and feel good about yourself.
  • Mentorship Program: Access development opportunities with the help of experienced professionals.
  • Gympass: To keep your health in check and take care of your body.
  • Snacks in the Office: Because everyone loves a snack at work!
  • Inclusive Environment: We value diversity and always strive to create a space where everyone can be authentic, respected, and feel part of something bigger.
  • Day off in Your Birthday Month: A day off in your birthday month to celebrate in any way you prefer.
  • Extended Maternity/Paternity Leave: So you can enjoy this important time with your family, with peace of mind that your professional life will remain well‑supported.
  • Childcare Assistance: To support you with the care of your young children.
  • Continuous Individualized Development Support: We offer support for your professional growth, respecting your personal needs and goals.
  • Culture and Well‑being: We create an environment that values mental health, work‑life balance, and encourages connection with culture.

The benefits provided with this position are not deducted from your paycheck!

title: Psicólogo - Nefrologia | Banco de Talentos
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver!
QUEM SOMOS:
A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.
Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.
Descrição :
Responsável por garantir o bom estado geral do paciente renal crônico em tratamento dialítico, colaborando na resolução de problemas psicológicos, trabalhando a autonomia e engajamento do paciente, respeitando sua individualidade.
Garantir a aderência do paciente renal ao tratamento dialítico, analisando e intervindo nas situações de não aderência, assim como nas situações de faltas às sessões de diálise.

  • O que você irá realizar
  • Entrevistar os pacientes novos na unidade, registrando os dados no prontuário do paciente ou meio eletrônico (somente serão registradas informações que tenham relevância ao tratamento dialítico);
  • Acompanhar o estado psicológico do paciente através de atendimento aos pacientes em diálise periodicamente, avaliando a pertinência de intervenções específicas e assistindo individualmente aqueles que necessitem;
  • Favorecer um ambiente adequado de diálise, a fim de propiciar a aderência do paciente ao tratamento, tornando o tempo de diálise em momento produtivo;
  • Trabalhar visando à integração entre pacientes;
  • Orientar os pacientes e familiares proporcionando o acesso envolvimento ao seu tratamento, por meio da educação continuada e juntamente equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Promover a integração da equipe multidisciplinar x pacientes e um apoio para as dificuldades encontradas no lidar com o paciente renal crônico através da realização de reuniões com a equipe de saúde;
  • Promover reuniões periódicas com pacientes, objetivando esclarecer dúvidas e orienta-los quanto às implicações emocionais e comportamentais no tratamento dialítico;
  • Analisar mensalmente relatórios de faltas de pacientes as sessões de diálise e realizar plano de ação visando melhorar a aderência do paciente renal a sessão;
  • Solicitar a presença de pacientes/familiares em eventos sociais auxiliando na promoção destes eventos juntamente com serviço Social;
  • Representar a ouvidoria do paciente junto à Unidade de Diálise e encaminhar reclamações/solicitações pertinentes aos setores competentes;
  • Garantir o registro das informações psicológicas do paciente através da confecção das evoluções periódicas no prontuário do paciente ou me meio eletrônico;
  • Participar de processos institucionais, programas e/ou projetos corporativos estabelecendo um relacionamento adequado com os clientes externos e internos;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões técnicas, administrativas e multidisciplinares (Reuniões de Qualidade, PCPIEA, etc) da unidade visando melhoria continua dos resultados da unidade;
  • Participar de reuniões e resultados clínicos da unidade, visando à elaboração de plano de ação para situações (Relatório de faltas às sessões, problemas relacionados à não aderência, e outros);
  • Garantir a autorização para atuar na empresa através do cumprimento das obrigações legais mediante ao Conselho Regional de Psicologia assim como cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética e atendimento aos requisitos legais.
  • Esperamos que você tenha
  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia;
  • CRP ativo e regular;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento clínico em Nefrologia;
  • Desejável especialização em Psicologia Clínica;
  • Disponibilidade para cumprir 30 horas semanais e/ou 44 horas semanais
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro
  • Oferecemos: Salário e Benefícios compatíveis ao mercado.

Na Fresenius oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.
A Fresenius Medical Care agradece o seu interesse e disponibilidade em participar de nosso processo seletivo!

title: Financial Systems Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Financial Systems Analyst role at Conservation International

This position is based in Arlington, VA, Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Bolivia, Peru, or Guyana.

Reporting to the Financial Systems Lead, this position supports CI’s current financial systems (Unit4 Business World and SAP Concur) and future systems, including a new cloud-based ERP system (Workday). The main focus is to support day‑to‑day operations by responding to help‑desk requests from system users globally and managing system security. This role also supports the generation of special financial and budget reports through SQL queries and advanced Excel applications as needed, and supports enhancement and development of existing and new applications, including design, data validation, testing, and training.

To be successful, you will need strong technical aptitude, experience as a user and a system manager, understanding of accounting and financial reporting, good customer service and communication skills, and the ability to triage and reprioritize case load. Patience with diverse user skill levels and determination to resolve issues timely are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Provide an approachable and responsive helpdesk service, supporting users of CI’s financial applications (Unit4 Business World and SAP Concur) globally.
  • Triage system issues/bugs raised by business users and work to find solutions.
  • Escalate complex issues as necessary, working with internal and external third parties to facilitate resolution.
  • Ensure timely follow‑up, resolution, and documentation of service requests.
  • Maintain financial system integrity, including setting up, administering, and terminating user accounts and maintaining complex workflow structures.
  • Support data quality checks and monitor changes to keep system records up‑to‑date.
  • Work with system providers and IT to facilitate installation and migration of software patches and upgrades.
  • Create and maintain system configuration to ensure optimal processing.
  • Assist in using, developing, and implementing financial system applications.
  • Support testing activities on finance projects, assisting with UAT for new systems, processes, and updates affecting finance operations.
  • Design special‑purpose reports for audits or other management uses.
  • Design processes and procedures for getting data into and out of financial systems as needed.
  • Maintain custom reports and forms in BW using BW report engine tools.
  • Maintain AG16s (SQL‑based customizations) in BW.
  • Participate in ad‑hoc tasks or projects as assigned by the supervisor.

Working Conditions

Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 4‑6 years of related experience in providing support for financial systems as a super user or system administrator.
  • Understanding of accounting processes and standards.
  • Solid working knowledge of relational and/or OLAP databases.
  • Experience working with MS SQL Server.
  • Experience with ERP reporting tools, particularly Power BI.
  • Accuracy and strong attention to detail.
  • Analytical mindset.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey financial or technical information to non‑financial/technical stakeholders.
  • Pro‑active problem‑solving approach.
  • Ability to plan own workload and resolve conflicting priorities, accountable for own actions.
  • Flexibility and adaptability.
  • Continually seeking ways to improve processes.
  • Passion, drive, and curiosity to challenge and ask questions.
  • English is the working language of the organization and this role.

Preferred

  • Experience with Business World Financials, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, Timesheets, and reporting modules.
  • Familiarity with Unit4 BW reporting tools and SQL‑based customizations (AG16s).
  • Cloud‑based ERP system implementation experience (e.g., Unit4 ERPx, Microsoft Dynamics F&O, Workday).
  • Experience with Workday Financials, Adaptive, or other Workday products.
  • Experience with SAP Concur administration.
  • Experience in the INGO sector.
  • Foreign language fluency, especially Spanish, French, and Portuguese.

To apply

Please submit a resume, cover letter, and respond to the position‑based questions in your application.

Conservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone.

  2. Refeitório no local
  3. Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  4. Café da manhã
  5. Auxílio creche
  6. Estacionamento no local para não optantes de VT

About Atacadão

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.
Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.
Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.
O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta e biodiversidade.

O Grupo Carrefour Brasil promove e incentiva a inclusão e a diversidade! Por isso, estimulamos a candidatura de mulheres, profissionais negros (as), LGBTI+ e de pessoas com deficiência.

title: Analista de Planejamento Sênior | Rio de Janeiro
description:
Analista de Planejamento Sênior | Rio de Janeiro

Join to apply for the Analista de Planejamento Sênior | Rio de Janeiro role at Pulse Client Experts

Nesta oportunidade de Analista de Planejamento Sr, você irá realizar o planejamento a curto, médio e longo prazo das áreas de atendimento receptivo e/ou ativo, observando cenários de forecast e dimensionamento de capacity disponível, visando a eficiência operacional alinhado ao planejamento estratégico da central de relacionamento.

Temos compromissos com a equidade de oportunidades para todas as pessoas. Valorizamos as diferenças e temos um ambiente onde todos e todas são mais que bem‑vindos, por isso buscamos diversidade em identidade de gênero, idade, cor e etnia, orientação afetivo‑sexual, origem, pessoas com deficiência e entre outras diversidades, pois entendemos que todas as pessoas devem sonhar, crescer e realizar.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar o forecast de chamadas a curto, médio e longo prazo das áreas de atendimento receptivo e/ou ativo;
  • Avaliar a necessidade de HC para as áreas receptivas e/ou ativas e/ou novos projetos e, caso necessário, solicitar novas contratações à área de Recrutamento & Seleção;
  • Controlar o capacity de atendimento, avaliando mudanças de comportamento em indicadores para propor a otimização de recursos;
  • Simular novos cenários de entrega de resultados das áreas de atendimento mediante premissas fornecidas e/ou conhecidas a fim de que a gestão possa tomar decisões tendo interações diretas com a alta gestão Pulse;
  • Realizar análises de tendência de indicadores a fim de prever mudanças nestes e avaliar necessidade de ações corretivas sugerindo melhorias nos processos e/ou nas atividades da operação buscando melhorias dos indicadores operacionais e NS;
  • Avaliar o desempenho das operações por meio da criação de quartis e dados estatísticos de desvio padrão identificando os outliers e sugerindo melhorias para estes;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores (KPIs) previamente definidos, apontando possíveis mudanças de comportamento e apoiar em tomada de decisões que evitem o comprometimento da entrega dos resultados;
  • Analisar o volume de chamadas da Central, tempo médio de atendimento (TMA), nível de serviço (NS), absenteísmo (ABS), turn over (TO), aderência (ADR), propondo ações em situações que estejam aquém do planejado;
  • Revisar escalas, pausas e descansos obrigatórios em conformidade com a NR17 e CLT;
  • Realizar o dimensionamento das operações de atendimento e elaborar escalas de trabalho através de Workforce;
  • Ser referência técnica para os analistas Jr, assistentes e jovens aprendizes;

Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida na área de Planejamento, domínio em dimensionamento e forecast;
  • Ter conhecimento avançado em Pacote Office (Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação para diferentes públicos;
  • Ter criatividade para resolução de problemas com agilidade, proatividade, visão sistêmica e analítica;
  • Experiência em construção de análises de indicadores para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e/ou operacionais;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial no Rio de Janeiro.

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores:

  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro(a) de Implantação de Projetos Pleno que será responsável pela execução e gestão de obras na área de gás, como gasodutos, SCCs, pontos de entrega e recebimento, estações de compressão, entre outros. A atuação será voltada ao acompanhamento técnico e operacional das obras, garantindo segurança, qualidade, cumprimento de prazos e integridade dos ativos.

Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar a execução física e financeira dos projetos, priorizando segurança do trabalho e qualidade técnica
  • Oferecer suporte técnico às equipes contratadas, promovendo alta produtividade
  • Elaborar, revisar e consolidar documentos técnicos para contratação de serviços (memoriais descritivos, cartas-convite, RFPs, termos de abertura)
  • Definir estratégias de contratação alinhadas às prioridades da NTS e aos requisitos dos projetos
Requisitos
  • Formação superior em Engenharia
  • Experiência em execução e gerenciamento de obras, preferencialmente no setor de gás
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de acompanhamento de cronogramas (MS Project, Excel, Primavera)

  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (3 a 4 dias por semana)
  • CNH ativa
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com elaboração de análise de risco
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de transporte por dutos ou áreas correlatas
  • Vivência com análise e gerenciamento de riscos
  • Inglês técnico desejável
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.
