Descrição da oportunidade

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa assessora sênior de impostos diretos, você será parte de Tax atuando em vários projetos globais e locais na área de Global Compliance and Reporting (GCR), ajudando grandes empresas a administrar e reduzir os riscos de suas operações, e assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Orientar a equipe na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos Imposto de Renda de Pessoas Jurídicas (IRPJ) e Contribuição Social sobre o Lucro Líquido (CSLL);
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Direcionar o trabalho de campo, gerenciar o desempenho da equipe e manter a liderança atualizada sobre os trabalhos, documentando as áreas de maior risco;
  • Desenvolver constantemente a sua compreensão das tendências e processos atuais do mercado e compartilhar o seu conhecimento para desenvolver a equipe;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Atuar como especialista em várias equipes de atendimento ao cliente, participando de projetos na área de Business Tax Advisory;
  • Prestar consultoria na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos.

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – Lucro real e lucro resumindo) e na preparação/revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Graduação em Administração, Direito ou Contabilidade.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Excel - intermedirário/avançado;
  • Inglês – nível intermediário.

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais.

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy‑only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb‑stop rate, 3‑second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI‑assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients.

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand‑holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy‑only with no hands‑on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Arquiteto (a) de Soluções / RJ
description:
Job Description

Os (as) Arquitetos (as) de Solução da Oracle fazem a conexão entre negócios e tecnologia para nossos clientes, criando soluções de valor. Combinando com um profundo conhecimento de tecnologia, aplicativos, melhores práticas do Business, processos de negócios e padrões de arquitetura para impulsionar iniciativas de transformação de TI que atendam aos objetivos de negócios de nossos clientes e que transmitam as mensagens para nossos clientes desde o público técnico quanto para o público Executivo C-Level. O entendimento dos diferentes cenários, a ênfase nos benefícios aos negócios, bem como levantamento e apresentação de casos de referências serão algumas das atividades principais da função. Internamente precisará trabalhar no alinhamento de conceitos, engajamento de recursos e profissionais, para, ao final apresentar uma proposta completa e aderente ao negócio do cliente. Trabalhar com atitude proativa, comprometimento e engajamento são as principais características que buscamos nas pessoas. Como arquiteto (a) de soluções, você tem a chance de se desenvolver em um espectro muito amplo, desde expertise em produtos, interação com clientes, comunicação, conhecimento em diversas áreas de negócios de nossos clientes e conhecimento geral do mercado de TI. A pessoa desta vaga precisa ter paixão por oferecer soluções de impacto positivo aos clientes, através da construção de relacionamentos duradouros e de excelência. Tudo isso, dentro de um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, sem uma rotina fixa e com foco na construção de confiança entre todas as partes envolvidas.

Responsibilities

  • Definir arquiteturas e propostas de soluções, utilizando técnicas de criação de valor ao negócio do cliente;
  • Apresentar e articular recursos e benefícios da solução de tecnologia Oracle para a clientes em potencial;
  • Colaborar com outras equipes de pré-vendas para gerar resultados de negócios, aumentar as taxas de ganhos e melhores propostas para o cliente;
  • Manter conhecimento atualizado e relevante de soluções competitivas e estratégias vencedoras;
  • Criar e entregar apresentações, demonstrações personalizadas, seminários, workshops além de conduzir e demonstrar casos de uso com as soluções da Oracle para nossos clientes;
  • Desenvolver parcerias sólidas com os clientes cultivando um relacionamento de confiança com foco na construção de uma percepção de valor positiva por parte do cliente;
  • Envolver-se com os clientes traduzindo suas necessidades de negócios em soluções apropriadas;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os clientes para identificar soluções que enderecem desafios de negócios;
  • A pessoa trabalhará com tecnologias em rápida evolução, componentes no local/nuvem para definir soluções exclusivas.

Essential Skills

  • Experiência como pré-vendas e/ou arquiteto de soluções;
  • Sólido conhecimento em licitações RFPs/RFIs, preferencialmente com alguma experiência atendendo a grandes contas;
  • Conhecimento de Arquitetura em nuvens públicas;
  • Experiência prática no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de projetos de migração de nuvem para nuvem (desejável on-premise para nuvem também);
  • Desenvolvimento de arquiteturas Cloud prioritariamente, de Data Center e Soluções em infraestrutura física (Hosting);
  • Soluções de servidores, storage, backup, sistema operacional, banco de dados e conectividade;
  • Conhecimentos em tecnologias de infraestrutura como banco de dados, middleware, aplicativos e hardware;
  • Soluções de replicação em ambiente físico e/ou nuvem e conceitos sobre RTO/RPO/DR;
  • Experiência com relacionamento com o cliente;
  • Experiência em Multi-Cloud e Infraestrutura de TI tradicional;

Desired Skills

  • Formação superior na área de tecnologia ou cursos relacionados;
  • Forte compreensão de desenvolvimento de sistemas utilizando estruturas Cloud Native, tradicionais monolíticas e sistemas distribuídos;
  • Visão de competitividade (Oracle, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc);
  • Ótima comunicação (escrita e verbal);
  • Inglês Intermediário;

Qualifications

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Enterprise Account Executive

We are a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales Teams.

Apply if you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system – Ubuntu – to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long‑term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long‑term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do — at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer — a real understanding of customer needs, industry‑specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect — the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology — a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork — a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy — the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.

What your day will look like

  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow‑up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account winsSelf‑discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional Skills Of Interest

  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Creative Strategist (Performance Creative)

Apply for the Creative Strategist (Performance Creative) role at Darkroom , our next‑generation growth marketing firm that blends human strategy with AI commerce.

About Darkroom

Founded in 2017, Darkroom redefines what a modern agency can be. Powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer, we deliver rapid, data‑driven creative and measurable impact across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms.

We have driven billions in attributable revenue and are recognized among the fastest‑growing private companies (Inc. 5000) and the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders appear in Forbes 30 Under 30.

The Role

We seek a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media on Meta, TikTok, and other platforms. You’ll own the performance creative service, marrying creative storytelling with data‑informed design to produce high‑volume, high‑impact ads.

What you’ll do

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy for full‑funnel ad programs on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.
  • Short‑Form Video: Provide expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products through short‑form video.
  • Data Analysis: Translate marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts, using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and CTR.
  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards. You may also create assets in Figma, Photoshop, or Illustrator as needed.
  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with confidence and strategic rationale.
  • Performance Iteration: Monitor data with the marketing team, iterate creative, and improve results over time.

Qualification & Experience

  • 3+ years of creative strategy on performance ad programs, focusing on short‑form video and statics.
  • Portfolio showcasing performance ad work (short‑form video, motion, statics) with evidence of impact on metrics like hold rate or CTR.
  • Proficiency in Figma (including Auto Layout & Components) and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and in client presentations.
  • Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, etc.) to increase speed and volume.
  • Ability to turn vague goals into testable concepts and lead iterative improvements.
  • Customer‑centric mindset, adept at navigating client pushback and delivering actionable feedback.

Hard Disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative experience.
  • No portfolio or performance context.
  • Strategy‑only role with no hands‑on design ability.
  • Weak client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom demands high performance, creativity, and ownership. Remote‑first culture with flexibility; hybrid option for New York or Lisbon hubs starting early 2026. We offer extensive parental leave, ongoing learning across disciplines, and a culture of autonomy with accountability.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal‑opportunity workplace—we are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

  • Planejar, configurar e acompanhar campanhas full-funnel (branding, performance, remarketing e brandformance).

  • Aplicar princípios de growth para descobrir novos caminhos de escala e eficiência.

  • Garantir integridade e consistência dos dados, incluindo tracking, UTMs e mapeamento de eventos.
  • Calcular e analisar impacto incremental de campanhas quando aplicável.

Requirements and skills

Para embarcar nesse desafio e se tornar um Beeper, você precisa ter:

1. Ferramentas e Plataformas (Domínio Esperado)

  • Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube).

description:
Resumo

Cria, revisa e implementa políticas, normas e procedimentos de segurança da informação para garantir a proteção dos dados e o cumprimento de normas e regulamentos. Desenvolve diretrizes de segurança para o uso seguro de redes, sistemas e aplicações. Realiza análise de riscos de segurança, identificando ameaças, vulnerabilidades e impactos potenciais para a organização. Propõe e implementa controles de segurança que mitigam os riscos identificados. Realiza avaliações regulares de risco em novos sistemas, aplicativos e atualizações de software. Monitora constantemente os sistemas de TI para identificar atividades suspeitas ou não autorizadas. Implementa e monitora sistemas de detecção de intrusão (IDS) e sistemas de prevenção de intrusão (IPS). Lidera e coordena respostas a incidentes de segurança cibernética, como violações de dados, malware, ransomware e outros tipos de ataques. Investiga incidentes, identifica a causa raiz e recomenda ações corretivas. Cria relatórios pós-incidente e desenvolve estratégias de prevenção para evitar futuras ocorrências. Conduz avaliações regulares de vulnerabilidade e testes de penetração (pentesting) para identificar fraquezas nos sistemas. Gerencia e prioriza a correção de vulnerabilidades por meio da aplicação de patches e atualizações de segurança. Gerencia e monitora sistemas de controle de acesso, assegurando que os usuários tenham apenas os privilégios necessários para realizar suas funções. Implementa e administra soluções de autenticação multifator (MFA) e sistemas de gerenciamento de identidades. Participa do desenvolvimento, manutenção e exercícios do Plano de Continuidade de Negócios e Plano de Recuperação de Desastres para garantir a continuidade das operações em caso de incidentes. Seleciona, especifica, configura e mantém ferramentas e tecnologias de segurança, como firewalls, antivírus, VPNs, sistemas de proteção de endpoints, DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e outros.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Design de Arquitetura de Segurança;
  • Experiência em Monitoramento e Resposta a Incidentes;
  • Experiência em Teste de intrusão;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Segurança de Redes, Segurança de Aplicações e Segurança em Cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Criptografia, Gestão de Identidade e Acesso (IAM).

Formação

Superior Completo em Sistemas de Informação, Gestão de Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins.

Oportunidade disponível para contratação híbrida nos escritórios de São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro e Curitiba.

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa Assessora Tributária Sênior de Preços de Transferência você será parte da área de TAX atuando na definição de preços dos produtos produzidos no exterior e vendidos no Brasil. Prestando assessoria tributária para atendimento as regras de preços de transferência realizando revisão, documentação, gerenciamento e defesa das políticas de preços de transferência, além da preparação de cálculos e documentos pertinentes para o cumprimento de obrigações principais e acessórias, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar projetos globais ou regionais de documentação de preços de transferência envolvendo diversas jurisdições - CbCR, Master File, Local File e Benchmark análises;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento, implementação e monitoramento de políticas de preços de transferência para empresas multinacionais brasileiras e internacionais;
  • Participar de projetos de auditoria para realizar revisões sob a ótica de preços de transferência;
  • Desenvolver a equipe nas melhores práticas de preços de transferência;
  • Desenvolver análises críticas;
  • Entender as linhas de serviço da EY e incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços que podemos oferecer aos nossos clientes;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Experiência na área de preços de transferência (in house ou Big4);
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente;
  • Graduação em economia, contabilidade ou administração;
  • Habilidade na comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade no trabalho em equipe e liderança.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Conhecimento em espanhol;
  • Habilidades analíticas financeiras e contábeis e domínio do pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

title: Líder de Manutenção Geral
description:
Encarregado

Descrição do Cargo:

O Encarregado de Manutenção é responsável por coordenar e supervisionar as atividades de manutenção em uma organização. Esse profissional desempenha um papel fundamental na garantia do bom funcionamento e conservação dos equipamentos, instalações e sistemas, além de assegurar a disponibilidade dos recursos necessários para o desempenho das atividades de manutenção. Abaixo estão algumas das principais responsabilidades desse cargo:

Responsabilidades:

1. Coordenação da equipe de manutenção: Supervisionar e orientar a equipe de manutenção, atribuindo tarefas, definindo prioridades e garantindo a execução eficiente das atividades de manutenção. Assegurar que os procedimentos e normas de segurança sejam seguidos pela equipe.

2. Planejamento e programação de atividades: Elaborar o planejamento das atividades de manutenção, considerando as demandas e prioridades da organização. Programar os serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, bem como as inspeções periódicas nos equipamentos e instalações.

3. Manutenção preventiva: Garantir a realização das atividades de manutenção preventiva de acordo com o cronograma estabelecido. Isso inclui a lubrificação, limpeza, ajustes e troca de peças conforme as recomendações dos fabricantes e normas técnicas.

4. Manutenção corretiva: Coordenar a equipe na resolução de problemas emergenciais, definindo as ações necessárias para a correção e reparo de equipamentos e sistemas. Assegurar a disponibilidade de recursos e materiais para a execução das atividades de manutenção corretiva de forma ágil.

5. Controle de estoque: Gerir o estoque de peças, materiais e ferramentas utilizados na manutenção, garantindo o suprimento adequado para as atividades programadas e emergenciais. Realizar o controle de entrada e saída de materiais, bem como a organização e conservação do almoxarifado.

6. Monitoramento e controle de indicadores: Acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho da equipe de manutenção, como tempo médio de reparo, disponibilidade dos equipamentos e custos de manutenção. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e implementar ações para otimizar a eficiência e reduzir os custos.

7. Gestão de fornecedores: Interagir com fornecedores de serviços e materiais de manutenção, buscando as melhores condições de contratação e negociação. Avaliar o desempenho dos fornecedores e garantir a qualidade dos serviços e materiais entregues.

Requisitos:

- Formação técnica em área relacionada à manutenção, como Eletrotécnica, Mecânica ou áreas afins.

- Experiência prévia em cargos de liderança na área de manutenção.

- Conhecimentos sólidos em técnicas e práticas de manutenção preventiva e corretiva.

- Habilidades de liderança, comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

- Conhecimento em normas de segurança e regulamentações relacionadas à manutenção.

- Capacidade de planejamento, organização e gestão de recursos.

- Conhecimento em sistemas informatizados de gestão de manutenção será um diferencial.

Background

  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

Authority

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Dismantle and reassemble instrumentation equipment
  • 1
  • Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
  • 2
  • Use correct procedures and method of dismantling.
  • 3
  • Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
  • 4
  • Identify, check and prepare components.
  • 5
  • Apply appropriate tests and testing equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Monitor and maintain the condition of instrumentation equipment.
  • 1
  • Adjust instruments to meet operational specifications.
  • 2
  • Adjust with minimum disruption to ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.
  • 3
  • Monitor and record work history in logs.
  • 3) Diagnose faults in equipment.
  • 1
  • Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • 2
  • Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
  • 3
  • Carry out visual, close, and detailed inspections on equipment.
  • 4
  • Use inspection results to determine appropriate actions.
  • 5
  • Record a complete and accurate description in the appropriate document history.
  • 4) Monitor and maintain pollution control measures.
  • 1
  • Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported per policy and regulations.
  • 2
  • Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
  • 3
  • Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are handled according to the correct procedure.
  • 4
  • Environmental protection and pollution control are effectively enforced with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 5) Emergency response
  • 1 Carry out emergency response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in emergency response drills and exercises.

Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies

Offshore – Demonstrate an understanding of PandAds Offshore – Handover Offshore – Diagnosis and fault finding Offshore – Reports Offshore – Computerised maintenance management system Offshore – Planning work Offshore – Dismantling, repair and reassemble equipment Offshore – Hazardous area classification Offshore – Safety management

Pre‑hire Qualifications and Experience

  • Proven experience and/or qualification to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Instrument Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Instrument/Mechanical isolation standards and risk assessment.
  • COMP ex e’X’ course preferred.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

Responsabilidades Da Posição

Profissional responsável pela operação de máquinas operatrizes convencionais em ambiente de usinagem de precisão, atuando em torno mecânico, fresadora ferramenteira e máquina de eletroerosão a fio, realizando setups, ajustes, usinagem de peças e controle dimensional conforme desenhos técnicos.

  • Garantir a qualidade das peças produzidas, evitando refugos e retrabalho, e registrar medições quando necessário.
  • Zelar pela conservação das máquinas, ferramentas e dispositivos, bem como pela organização e limpeza do posto de trabalho (5S).
  • Cumprir rigorosamente normas de segurança do trabalho e procedimentos internos da empresa.

  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Operação de torno mecânico convencional;
  • Operação de fresadora ferramenteira;
  • Operação de máquina de eletroerosão a fio (mesmo que não seja programador pleno).
  • Conhecimentos em:
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos;
  • Processos de usinagem convencional;
  • Metrologia e controle dimensional.
  • Escolaridade:
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Desejável curso profissionalizante na área de usinagem/mecânica (SENAI ou equivalente).

description:
You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).

  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations. We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions, storage operations in Preá, and final-mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply-chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

  • Mid‑Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  • Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  • Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  • Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  • Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  • Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  • Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  • Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  • Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe)
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia's standards for quality, specifications, and finishes

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes)
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá‑Jericoacoara transfers

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards

Requirements

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred)
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus)
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable
  • Portuguese and English a must—any other language a plus

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports)
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs)

Benefits

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.
